main_text.p: 2. munus quod offert Deo reiicitur, versic. 5. occidit fratrem Abelem, & quare, versi. 8.2. Ioan. 3.versi.12. Hebr. 12.24. a Deo maledicitur, Genesis 4, 11. ciuitatem extruit, versic. 17. ex Diabolo est, 1. Ioann. 3 12. [Via Cain, Iud. versicul. 11.]

CALAMVS, instrumentum quo pingimus literas, Psalm. 45. 2.3. Iohan. 13. Instrumentum ad mensurandum, Ezech. 40. ver. 3.5.6 7. & 41.8. & 42.16. &c. & 48, 8. Aromatis species, Esa. 43 24. Ierem. 6.20. Ezech. 27.19. Ramus in candelabro tabernaculi, Exod. 25.v.31 32. &c. & 30 23. & 37.17. &c. pro arundine, Esa. 42.3 Matt. 12.20.
CALCEAMENTVM: Calceamenta Israelitarum per desertum non attrita, Deut. 8, 4. & 29,5. Calceamenta in pedibus conedentium Agnum Paschalem, Exodi 12,11.

CALCEI detractio & traditio signum erat alienatæ possessionis & translatę: Deut. 25 9. Ruth. 4.7. In ornamenta calceamentorū. &c. Isa. 3.18. In eos qui pro pari calceorū iustum vēdūt: Amos. 2.6. Baptista se indignū dicit qui calceamenta seu soleas Christi, oportet aut soluat (quibus verbis infimi serui conditio notatur) Matt. 3.11. Marc. 1.7. Luc. 3.16. Calceamenta ne sint Apostolis remoræ: Matt. 10.10.
CALCULUS, 2 Sam. 17.13. Esai. 6. 6. Calculus albus, Apoc. 2,17.

CALEB, filius Iephone, Numer. 14,6 filius Hesronis, 1. Par. 2, 18. vir pius terram chanaan cum Iosua laudat, Num. 14. v. 7,8. terra Chanaan illi promittitur, v. 24. Deut. 1. v. 35.36. hanc sibi dari postulat, Iosue 14. v. 6,12. & 21, 12. Iudic. 1,20. 1 Paral. 6,56. Senectus eius florens & fortis, Iosue 14. v. 10.11. tres filios & nac possessione sua expellit, Iosue 15.14. (. omni corde adhærens Deo.)
CALENDAE, prima dies mensis, Numer. 10,10. & 28 11. Esai. 1. 4. Ezech. 45 17. & 46. .1,3,6.]

CALIGO metaphorice, pro longe miserrima viuendi conditione, 2. Petri 2 4. Caligo tenebrarum, pro densissimis tenebris, per Hebraismum, 2. Petr. 2.17. Iudæ v. 13.] Caligo, i. aeris opacitas, aliquoties diuinæ maiestatis velum, Gen. 15.17. Exo. 19.9. & 20.21. & 24.16. Psal. 18. 10. & 97.2. Caligo, i. miseria & graui s calamitas, vel externa, vel interna, Pro.
